facts.fact: 浴缸里她第一次自问：爱是这个感觉吗？
facts.anchor: Is this what love feels like?

facts.fact: 她的成长史：每次触碰都是交易、每次亲密都是待被利用的弱点。
facts.anchor: I had been conditioned from infancy to believe that every touch was a transaction

facts.fact: 她第一次主动交底：我是为了逃离母亲才嫁进来的。
facts.anchor: "I agreed to marry into your family to get away from my mother."

facts.fact: 计划修订：原方案作废——她不再毁 Blackwood。
facts.anchor: That plan was over. I wasn't going to destroy the Blackwoods.

facts.fact: 她承认：母亲派我来监视你。
facts.anchor: "My mother asked me to spy on you."

facts.fact: 他听完只是把人抱紧、把脸埋进她湿发里。
facts.anchor: He lowered his face into my damp hair and breathed me in.

facts.fact: 他只回三个词：我相信你。
她的承诺：我绝不伤你，也不许别人伤你。
她第一次说想朝他跑，而不是跑开。
facts.anchor: I want to run to you.

facts.fact: 章末：她一生都在找出口，结果找到了他。
facts.anchor: I'd spent my whole life looking for a way out. I'd found him instead.
